common_task: 7x5 prior OHLCV; y=std population seven close-price log returns through next dailyUTC close; metric primary unchanged
cross_panel_dependence: All share provider and crypto factors; BTCspot/BTCperps share underlying, USD-M/COIN-M share shocks. No claim of three statistically independent markets or independent final evidence. Between-dataset test with3additional has limited power; report per-panel effects and consistent/discordant signs.
final_reserve: No current historical calendar is certified unexposed. Development only. New final supports require authentic reserved history or after full protocol lock, same method family and frozen sizing.
selection_survival_rule: If source dates/contract/calendar/rights cannot be verified before any model fit, mark unavailable and record prospective replacement before acquiring alternatives; never choose by forecast metrics.
prior_exposure_disclosure: F02 overlaps archived BTCUSD_PERP D03 observations and model results; F00 and BTC/ETH underlyings have historical development exposure. This proposal does not claim source selection preceded all historical results. Its fixed calendars are development-only. Any confirmatory additional evidence must come from an authentic untouched reserve or post-protocol support after this amendment and frozen sizing.
